name: vscode-debug-mcp
description: MCP server exposing VS Code debugging, terminals, debug console, launch configurations, and tasks to AI assistants.

commands.title: Debug MCP: Install Claude Code Support…
Debug MCP: Uninstall Claude Code Support…

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_list_launch_configurations
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the debug configurations defined in launch.json across the open workspace folders. Use this BEFORE asking the user how to run something — they likely already configured it.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_start_debugging
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start a VS Code debug session by launch.json configuration name. Prefer this over running the program via the terminal — the user gets a real interactive debug session with breakpoints, variable inspection, and the debug console.

name.description: Configuration name from launch.json. Omit to use the default.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_stop_debugging
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop the active VS Code debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_continue_execution
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Continue execution in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_step_over
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Step over the current statement in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_step_in
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Step into the next function call in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_step_out
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Step out of the current function in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_get_threads
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List threads in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_get_stack_trace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the stack trace for a thread in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_get_scopes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the variable scopes for a given stack frame in the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_get_variables
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the variables under a given variablesReference (from get_scopes or a parent variable).

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_evaluate_expression
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate an expression in the active debug session. Avoid side-effecting expressions — they will mutate the running program.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Evaluate an expression at the current frame

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_get_all_breakpoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all breakpoints registered in VS Code.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_set_breakpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a source breakpoint at the given file and 1-based line. Use absolute paths.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_remove_breakpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove a breakpoint by its ID (from get_all_breakpoints).

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_clear_all_breakpoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove every breakpoint in VS Code. Destructive — confirms with the user first.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_toggle_breakpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Toggle a source breakpoint at the given file/line (1-based).

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_list_tasks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all tasks visible to VS Code (workspace tasks.json + extension-contributed). Use this before suggesting a way to run a build/test/dev server — the user likely already defined a task.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_run_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a VS Code task by name. Prefer this over running commands directly in the terminal — tasks are visible to the user in VS Code and they can stop them. 'source' disambiguates when multiple tasks share a name.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_list_running_tasks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List tasks currently being executed by VS Code.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_stop_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop running task(s) by name (optionally filtered by source).

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_list_terminals
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List terminals captured via VS Code shell integration.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_read_terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read captured output from a terminal by id or name. Each captured command is bracketed by a $ command header and a [exit N] footer.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_run_in_terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send a command to a VS Code terminal. Prefer 'run_task' for anything the user might want to re-run.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a command in a terminal

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_read_debug_console
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read captured output from the VS Code debug console for the active or recent debug sessions.

languageModelTools.name: debugMcp_eval_in_debug_console
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate an expression in the debug console REPL of the active session. Avoid side-effecting expressions.

vscodeDebugMcp.port.description: Port for the MCP Streamable HTTP server.

vscodeDebugMcp.host.description: Host interface to bind the MCP server to.

vscodeDebugMcp.autoStart.description: Start the MCP server automatically when the extension activates.

vscodeDebugMcp.terminalBufferLines.description: Maximum lines of output retained per captured terminal/debug-console.
